text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! What a lovely gift idea, your sister is lucky. 🌿

Here are the answers to both of your questions:

- **Will she see what you paid?** No. Prices are never printed on gift packing slips, so the cost stays private.
- **Can you add a message?** Yes! Gift orders come with a free printed gift note, up to 200 characters.

A couple of things that might help with planning:

- Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. If you order after 12 noon on Wednesday, the plant will ship the following Monday.
- Live plants can't be delivered to PO boxes, so make sure you use her street address.
- Standard shipping is free on orders of $75 or more (after discounts, before tax). Otherwise it's $7.95.

I'd be happy to help with anything else, like delivery times to her area. Just let me know. Happy gifting! 🌱
